label: QAP technical score
description: Meet the technical scoring categories in the Alaska Qualified Allocation Plan for the program year. Exact criteria vary year-to-year per the current QAP.

scoring.desc: Application misses several QAP scoring categories or has disqualifying omissions.
Application covers most QAP categories but leaves points on the table in areas such as targeting or amenities.
Application maximizes QAP points in targeting, amenities, and service commitments relevant to the current QAP.

common_failures: Targeting set-asides that do not match the QAP categories

label: Development team experience
description: Show a developer, architect, and general contractor team with Alaska affordable-housing experience.

scoring.desc: Team has Alaska experience but limited at the proposed scale.
Team has multiple comparable Alaska projects delivered on time and on budget.

common_failures: General contractor never bonded in Alaska

label: Financial feasibility
description: Present sources-and-uses, debt-service coverage, and operating pro-forma that pencil for a 15-year compliance period.

scoring.desc: Pro-forma does not meet minimum DSCR or has unrealistic operating assumptions.
Pro-forma meets minimum DSCR but vacancy or operating cost assumptions are thin.
Pro-forma meets DSCR with defensible operating assumptions, replacement reserves, and stress-tested vacancy.

common_failures: Vacancy assumption below Alaska rural norms
Utility allowances inconsistent with local PHA schedule

label: Site and community fit
description: Document site control, zoning, utilities, and community support including local government and tribal partners where applicable.

scoring.desc: Site control is not evidenced or community support is absent.
Site control exists but community support letters are generic.
Site is controlled, zoned, and has active community and tribal or local-government support documented in writing.

label: Long-term affordability and services
description: Commit to deeper affordability, longer compliance periods, or on-site supportive services beyond QAP minimums.

scoring.desc: One commitment beyond minimums but not memorialized in a restrictive covenant.
Multiple commitments beyond minimums memorialized in the LURA or service agreements with community providers.

common_failures: Service commitments without a service provider MOU
Affordability term only at QAP minimum
